related_matches.title: Scoped negative result: sixth-root phases retain the 14-call connector minimum
related_matches.head: be8768d5fd8e9e7a1f714424f25b34b0e807daa0
related_matches.excerpt:
Allowing sixth-root-of-unity coefficients invalidates the signed connector's even-call argument, because three nonreal phases can sum to zero. This **scoped negative result** closes that gap for PR944/PR1088's three-by-three target: the enlarged characteristic-zero alphabet still needs **14 complete queries**, and its exact optimum under positive phase-independent complete-query tariffs remains `2 sum_F c_F + 2 min_F c_F`.

The written reduction covers every 12- and 13-call multiplicity profile.
